g.text: Actual power-eight front, unchanged inverse back and retained native rays
Coordinates in original L; 1 L = 88.5 native pixels. Both axes use equal scale in each panel.
expanded: longitudinal section and x-z projected actual native paths
Blue: actual front. Orange: actual back. Gray: retained primary paths. Dashed: background plane.
Transverse section: equal axes; no independent lens drawing.
compact: longitudinal section and x-z projected actual native paths
Blue: actual front. Orange: actual back. Gray: retained primary paths. Dashed: background plane.
Transverse section: equal axes; no independent lens drawing.
